items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Oh, he was a good man, but he also got into that dope business, you know. God bless him, he died.

ctx.x: Yeah, Paul. He's sleeping out there in front of the public, sleeping and so forth like that -- Oh, he take a lot of things. (Unintelligible) how can you take all that? I don't know. I guess he figured he couldn't get anybody like him.
But Paul was a beautiful player when he was awake and playing.
